title: A live split shell is hidden as a finished run
detail:
A live split shell is hidden as a finished run

native/crates/attn-app/src/sidebar/model.rs:869

Split a shell beside an automation run or one of its delegates, then switch desktops. The shell's parent links it to the automation and the daemon reports the shell idle. The sidebar folds the shell behind Finished runs while the terminal remains open and usable. Keep live split shells visible in Automations without counting them as completed runs.
